summary: Feed s158_double to IDS is degraded: VLAN 20 traffic is missing (50% untagged) and encrypted share at 66% exceeds IDS tolerance of 60%, reducing payload visibility for signature detection.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags or not trunking VLAN 20 - 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is never observed despite IDS requiring VLANs 10 and 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to VLAN 20 segment; misses lateral movement, segmentation violations and attacks scoped to that VLAN, halving effective coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and preserve VLAN tags through the broker so IDS receives correctly tagged traffic for VLAN 20 and can apply VLAN-aware policies.

findings.root_cause: 66% of bytes are TLS/encrypted, above the 60% this IDS can tolerate with full-payload inspection. Likely growth in encrypted east-west or internet traffic without broker-side decryption.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload for signature matching; encrypted payloads cannot be inspected, so detection coverage drops and malicious payloads hide in TLS.

params.suggestion: offload selective TLS decryption to packet broker or add NDR with JA3/metadata analysis

recommended_fix.why: Decrypt relevant TLS centrally or supplement with metadata-based detection to bring inspectable traffic back within IDS effective range without overloading the 1Gbps tool port.
